name: GPU Multi-Volume Ray Casting Mapper
aliases: GPU Multi Volume Ray Cast Mapper
definition: A base class for GPU-accelerated volume ray casting that supports multiple volumes, adaptive sampling, masking, and AMR (Adaptive Mesh Refinement) mode. It manages the rendering pipeline through PreRender, RenderBlock, and PostRender hooks.
summary: The GPU Multi-Volume Ray Casting Mapper is a hardware-accelerated technique that renders multiple 3D scalar fields simultaneously by compositing them along a single ray in one pass.
